title: Amazon Nears Deal for Globalstar in Push to Rival Musk’s Starlink
title_zh: 亚马逊接近达成 Globalstar 交易，向竞争对手马斯克的 Starlink 发起冲击
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Amazon.com Inc. is in advanced talks to acquire satellite operator Globalstar Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——亚马逊公司正在就收购卫星运营商 Globalstar Inc. 进行深入谈判。

title: Stock Futures Rise as Markets Hope for Iran Deal
title_zh: 由于市场希望伊朗达成协议，股票期货上涨
summary: Stocks looked set to edge higher and oil prices were falling on Tuesday as investors hoped for a peace deal to end the war in Iran, even as the U.S. blockade of the Strait of Hormuz stretched into a second day.
summary_zh: 尽管美国对霍尔木兹海峡的封锁已持续到第二天，但由于投资者希望达成和平协议以结束伊朗战争，周二股市似乎将小幅走高，油价下跌。

title: Amazon nears deal to buy Globalstar, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，亚马逊即将达成收购 Globalstar 的交易
summary: Amazon is in ‌advanced talks ‌to acquire satellite ​telecom group Globalstar, a deal that would bolster ‌the ⁠tech major's push to build ⁠its own satellite operation, ​Bloomberg ​News ​reported on ‌Monday.
summary_zh: 据彭博新闻周一报道，亚马逊正在就收购卫星电信集团 Globalstar 进行高级谈判，这笔交易将支持这家科技巨头建立自己的卫星运营业务。

title: Bloom Energy Stock Jumps on Expanded Fuel Cell Deal for Oracle
title_zh: 甲骨文扩大燃料电池交易，Bloom Energy 股价上涨
summary: Bloom’s fuel cells will support Oracle projects in the U.S. amid demand for its AI and cloud-computing infrastructure.
summary_zh: Bloom 的燃料电池将支持 Oracle 在美国的项目，以满足对其人工智能和云计算基础设施的需求。

title: US Equity Indexes Rise Amid Gains in Tech, Financials; Crude Oil Pares Gains on Hopes for Iran Deal
title_zh: 美国股指因科技、金融股上涨而上涨；由于伊朗协议的希望，原油涨幅回落
summary: US equity indexes rose, with financials and technology topping sector charts, and crude oil futures
summary_zh: 美国股指上涨，金融和科技股位居板块榜首，原油期货上涨
